# disable

Disable solution cloud flows (does not cancel existing runs)

## Usage

```
ppds flows disable [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` |  | `bool` |  | All eligible cloud-flow definitions in --solution |
| `--confirm-env` |  | `string` |  | Acknowledge the exact resolved environment URL |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Inspect a fresh plan without writing |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Environment URL override |
| `--expected-plan-hash` |  | `string` |  | Require this dry-run plan fingerprint before writes |
| `--id` |  | `Guid?` |  | Exact workflow ID |
| `--max-flows` |  | `int?` |  | Maximum eligible flow count (default 100); exceeding it fails without writes |
| `--name` |  | `string` |  | Exact flow unique/schema name |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Filter by solution unique name |
| `--timeout` |  | `int?` |  | State-verification deadline per flow in seconds (1-3600; default 60) |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
